paite: Upa in, tel a om numei leh atate thutak a ka it, kei kia hilou a, thutak thei peuhmahte kiang ah;
heading: Chibai Bukna
english: The elder, to the chosen lady and her children, whom I love in truth, and not I only, but also all those who know the truth,

paite: thutak eimah a om gige, tangtawn a i kiang ua om gige ding ahih ziak in;
english: for the truth’s sake, which remains in us, and it will be with us forever:

paite: Pa Pathian a kipan leh Pa' Tapa, Toupa Jesu Khrist a kipan hehpihna, zahngaihna, leh khamuanna in thutak leh itna ah noute hon ompih hen.
english: Grace, mercy, and peace will be with us, from God the Father and from the Lord Jesus Christ, the Son of the Father, in truth and love.

paite: Pa kiang a kipan athupiak i muh bang in na ta kuate hiam thutak a om a ka muh ziak in ka kipak mahmah hi.
heading: Khrist Thupiak Zuihna
english: I rejoice greatly that I have found some of your children walking in truth, even as we have been commanded by the Father.

paite: Numei hoih, na kiang a thupiak thak gelh hilou in, atung a kipan a i neih pen gelh zaw in, i ki-ittuah theihna ding in nget petmah in ka hon ngen hi.
english: Now I beg you, dear lady, not as though I wrote to you a new commandment, but that which we had from the beginning, that we love one another.

paite: Huan hiai itna ahi, athupiak bang zel a i omna uh. Hiai ahi thupiak atung a kipat ana zak uh, huai ah na om ding uh ahi.
english: This is love, that we should walk according to his commandments. This is the commandment, even as you heard from the beginning, that you should walk in it.

paite: Jesu Khrist taksa in ahong pai chih gum lou khemmi tampi khovel ah ahong pawtta uhi. Huai mite ahi, khemmi leh Khrist doumi.
english: For many deceivers have gone out into the world, those who don’t confess that Jesus Christ came in the flesh. This is the deceiver and the Antichrist.

paite: I sepkhiaksate mangsak lou a, akipahman bukim a i muhtheihna ding un, nangmah kivenghoih in.
english: Watch yourselves, that we don’t lose the things which we have accomplished, but that we receive a full reward.

paite: Kuapeuh huai Khrist thu sinsakna thu a om gige lou a talek in Pathian anei kei. Huai thu sinsakna thu a a-om gige in Pa leh Tapa aneikhawm hi.
english: Whoever transgresses and doesn’t remain in the teaching of Christ doesn’t have God. He who remains in the teaching has both the Father and the Son.

paite: Kuapeuh huai thu sinsakna thu hon po lou a, na kiang ua ahong paileh na inn uah tungsak kei unla, paukam hoih in kha sam kei un,
english: If anyone comes to you and doesn’t bring this teaching, don’t receive him into your house, and don’t welcome him,

paite: paukam hoih a kha peuhmah athilhihkhelh ah panna anei ngal a.
english: for he who welcomes him participates in his evil deeds.

paite: Na kiang ua thu tampi gen ding ka neih ziak in lai leh laitui a gelh ka ut kei a; na kipahna uh akimtheihna ding in na kiang ua hong hoh a, kimaituah a kihou ka lamen zaw hi.
heading: Thu Nanungte
english: Having many things to write to you, I don’t want to do so with paper and ink, but I hope to come to you and to speak face to face, that our joy may be made full.

paite: Na sanggamnu tel tate un chibai ahon buk uhi, Amen.
english: The children of your chosen sister greet you. Amen.
